title: Observable Qwen3 14B pull and native tool validation
description: Replace opaque REST pull with observable Ollama CLI pull against the exact OpenClaw Ollama endpoint, emit heartbeat/progress, enforce a 15 minute timeout, reuse partial layers, then validate genuine structured message.tool_calls.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$model='qwen3:14b';$ollama=(Get-Command ollama.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source;$log=Join-Path $root 'qwen3-14b-pull.log';$err=Join-Path $root 'qwen3-14b-pull.err.log';Remove-Item $log,$err -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$old=$env:OLLAMA_HOST;$env:OLLAMA_HOST=$base;try{Write-Output ('V444B_057M2_PULL_START='+$model+' endpoint='+$base);$p=Start-Process -FilePath $ollama -ArgumentList @('pull',$model) -RedirectStandardOutput $log -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden;$deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(15);while(-not $p.HasExited){if((Get-Date) -ge $deadline){try{$p.Kill()}catch{};throw '057M2_PULL_TIMEOUT_15M'};Start-Sleep -Seconds 15;$tail='';if(Test-Path $err){$tail=((Get-Content $err -Tail 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)-join ' ')};if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($tail) -and (Test-Path $log)){$tail=((Get-Content $log -Tail 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)-join ' ')};Write-Output ('V444B_057M2_HEARTBEAT='+((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss'))+' '+$tail)};$p.Refresh();if($p.ExitCode -ne 0){throw ('057M2_PULL_EXIT_'+$p.ExitCode)};Write-Output 'V444B_057M2_PULL_STATUS=SUCCESS'}finally{$env:OLLAMA_HOST=$old};$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{model=$model}|ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 60;$caps=@($show.capabilities);$supportsTools=($caps -contains 'tools');$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$body=@{model=$model;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='system';content='You are a tool-using agent. When a matching tool is available, call it. Do not answer with JSON, XML, markdown, or prose instead of a tool call.'},@{role='user';content='Call write_probe exactly once with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/qwen3-native-tool-probe.txt and content QWEN3_NATIVE_TOOL_OK.'});tools=@($tool);options=@{temperature=0}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 600;$msg=$resp.message;$props=if($null -ne $msg){@($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name)}else{@()};$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};$calls=@($tc|ForEach-Object{[pscustomobject]@{name=[string]$_.function.name;arguments=$_.function.arguments}});$artifact=Join-Path $root 'qwen3-14b-native-tool-validation.json';[pscustomobject]@{testedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');endpoint=$base;model=$model;capabilities=$caps;supportsTools=$supportsTools;messageProperties=$props;toolCallCount=$tc.Count;structured=($tc.Count -gt 0);toolCalls=$calls}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20|Set-Content $artifact -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V444B_057M2_CAPS='+($caps -join ','));Write-Output ('V444B_057M2_TOOL_CALL_COUNT='+$tc.Count);Write-Output ('V444B_057M2_STRUCTURED='+($tc.Count -gt 0));Write-Output ('V444B_057M2_ARTIFACT='+$artifact)
